name: symbolon-records
status: Public. Version 1.1 adds R.08, R.09 and R.10, and new R.06 records.
description: Text records for five Symbolon research entries (R.01 Latent channel, R.06 Binding failure mechanism, R.08 Uncertainty carrier, R.09 Split learning at equal bits, R.10 Replay in learned message channels). Version 1.0 files come from a recovered historical snapshot of the Ember project. Version 1.1 files come from the study folders of 2026-10-20 to 2026-10-25.

path_conventions.original_path: Path relative to the root of the recovery snapshot. The location of the snapshot on disk is withheld.
path_conventions.new_path: Path relative to the root of this repository.
path_conventions.records_root: records/ has the same layout as the old Ember project root. Scrubbed relative paths in the records are relative to records/.
path_conventions.original_path_v1_1: For version 1.1 files: the path relative to the root of the 2026-10 snapshot folder. The location of that folder is withheld.

hash_checks.sha256_original: SHA-256 of the file in the recovery snapshot, computed on 2026-10-19.
hash_checks.sha256_copy: SHA-256 of the file in this repository. It is equal to sha256_original if scrubbed and redacted are both false.
hash_checks.scrubbed: True if local paths were replaced in the copy (SCRUB_LOG.json, files).
hash_checks.redacted: True if a quote of private chat was replaced by '[redacted: private chat]' in the copy (SCRUB_LOG.json, redactions). A redacted original cannot be rebuilt from this repository.
hash_checks.sha256_recovery_manifest: SHA-256 that the recovery tool recorded on 2026-09-30 (integrity/recovery-manifest-lines.jsonl). Null for files that are newer than the recovery.
hash_checks.sha256_in_seal: SHA-256 that the seal file of the folder (seal_file) lists for this file. Null if no seal lists the file.
hash_checks.sha256_in_freeze: SHA-256 that the E3 freeze lists for this program file. Only for latent_anchor_program_20260930 files.
hash_checks.sha256_original_v1_1: For version 1.1 files: SHA-256 of the file in its study folder, computed on 2026-10-25.
hash_checks.sha256_in_seal_v1_1: For version 1.1 files: the SHA-256 that the SEAL.json of the folder lists under 'sha256'. Only 3 of the 11 version 1.1 folders have a seal.
hash_checks.freeze_v1_1: For version 1.1 files the freeze fields are null (not computed). Each study folder has its own FREEZE.json with the hashes of its frozen code and inputs.

rules.meaning: Old project root with a slash. Replaced by nothing, so the path becomes relative to records/.
Old project root without a slash. Replaced by '.', the project root (records/).
Other paths in the home folder (for example the Hugging Face cache). The home folder becomes <local>.
The home folder without a slash. Replaced by <local>.

recovery_manifest_lines.note: The lines of the recovery manifest for every file in the folders in scope (included and excluded). The only change: the withheld location of the snapshot was removed from the start of each 'destination' value, so 'destination' is relative to the snapshot root. The 'source' value is the path inside the USB backup.

known_issues: latent_anchor_program_20260930/lab.py and sweep.py in the snapshot do not match the hashes in latent_anchor_E3_20261003/FREEZE.json. Both files changed on 2026-10-03, after the E3 seal (16:37:01Z). The frozen versions are not in the snapshot. The copies here are the later versions.

Four files have one redaction each (a direct quote of private chat): latent_anchor_E3_20261003/PREREGISTRATION.md, latent_binding_diagnosis_20260914/REPORT.md, latent_binding_training_fold_recovery_20260913/PLAN.md and latent_binding_matched_fold_probe_20260914/PLAN.md. Their copies do not agree with the seal or the freeze of their folder. sha256_original is the sealed hash.

Three files that the site cites by hash are scrubbed: latent_channel_v2_20260906/run_final/analysis.json, latent_channel_smollm_20260906/run_final/analysis.json and latent_binding_validation_ladder_20260910/SUMMARY.json. The site hash is the hash of the original (sha256_original). The copy differs only in the path strings that SCRUB_LOG.json lists.

Version 1.1: 8 of the 11 study folders have no SEAL.json (the uncertainty pilot and follow-up, the format-gap study, the replay and influence studies, and the three R.06 folders). For their files, sha256_original is the hash on 2026-10-25. latent_uncertainty_confirm_20261021, split_equal_bits_20261023 and split_leak_replication_20261024 are sealed.

Version 1.1: rule R14 replaced the researcher's name by [researcher] in 159 places in process files, and rule R15 replaced it in 22 code identifiers. Data files are not changed, because they hold TriviaQA text that has the same word as a place or person name.
Version 1.1: 27 direct quotes of private chat (approvals) are redacted in 17 files. 2 passages that name a model release or a study that is not public yet are redacted as unpublished.

Version 1.1: per-item files with TriviaQA questions, Wikipedia passages and model answers are not included. The frozen fetch and run code of each folder rebuilds them. The result files that the entries cite are included.
Version 1.1: some scripts and logs name the folders of other studies (as start conditions of the job chain). Those studies are not part of this package.

Version 1.1: latent_r06_localization_cpu_20261020 broke a standing rule of the project (no saved-array trial on the eight burned IDs). Its REPORT.md has a rule note. R.06 does not use its results as evidence.
